name: Saimin Paranoia
source:
Here's a brand new game for all you hypnosis fans out there. Partner up with a sexy magician and use her powers of hypnotism to gain control over 8 cute girls, then live out your most depraved sexual fantasies. She can make them do anything, even believe they're characters in your favorite erotic manga! A great game for fans of dark sexual content.

[From J-List]
